title: S-1: Anthropic warns prospective investors that its AI safety and advocacy stances risk disproportionate and selective targeting from the Trump administration (Maria Curi/Axios)
summary: Maria Curi / Axios: S-1: Anthropic warns prospective investors that its AI safety and advocacy stances risk disproportionate and selective targeting from the Trump administration — Anthropic is warning investors that it may continue to be a target of the Trump administration as it seeks one of the biggest IPOs in history …
